descriptionMarkdown:
Power Tag Rule
Focused Rupture Universal Action. Range 90 ft. Intelligence save. Failure: 3d8 force damage; success: half. If this kills 
the target, reduce Warp Pressure by 1.
Assail Telekinesis, Universal Action. Range 60 ft. Choose up to three creatures. Psychic attack against each target. Hit: 
1d6 force damage.
Psychic Shield Telekinesis, Universal Action. Range 30 ft. One creature gains temporary HP equal to 1d8 + psychic ability modifier 
+ proficiency bonus and advantage on fear saves while they remain.
Soulfire Pyromancy, Universal Action. Range 60 ft. Dexterity save. Failure: 2d6 fire/radiant damage and burns for 1d6 at the 
start of the next turn; success: half and no burn.
Dominate Nerve Biomancy, Universal Action. Range 60 ft. Wisdom save. Failure: no reactions and disadvantage on next attack 
roll.
Warp Step Universal Bonus Action. Teleport 30 ft to a visible unoccupied space. Immediately roll for Perils even if 
Warp Pressure would not normally trigger it.
Blood Surge Biomancy Bonus Action. Range 30 ft. One ally gains +10 ft speed and advantage on Strength checks 
for 1 minute.
Toxic Bloom Biomancy Action. 10-ft radius within 60 ft. Constitution save. Failure: 2d8 poison/necrotic damage and 
poisoned until next turn; success: half and no poison.
Kinetic Bulwark Telekinesis Reaction. When an ally within 30 ft is hit, reduce damage by 2d8 + psychic ability modifier.
Crush Grip Telekinesis Action. Range 60 ft. Strength save. Failure: 2d8 force damage, and speed becomes 0 until 
the end of the next turn.
Fate’s Nudge Divination Reaction. Add or subtract 1d4 from a d20 roll made by a creature you can see within 60 ft.
Prescient Aim Divination Bonus Action. Range 60 ft. One ally gains advantage on their next ranged attack before your 
next turn.
Cleansing Wave Pyromancy Action. 15-ft cone. Dexterity save. Failure: 3d6 fire/radiant damage; success: half. Daemons 
and corrupted creatures take +1d6.
Burning Halo Pyromancy Bonus Action. Self. 1 minute. Creatures that hit you with melee attacks take fire damage 
equal to your proficiency bonus.
Terror Echo Malefic Action. Range 60 ft. Wisdom save. Failure: frightened until the end of the next turn and takes 
2d6 psychic damage.
Baleful Rupture Malefic Action. Range 90 ft. Intelligence save. Failure: 4d8 psychic damage; success: half. Add +1 
extra Warp Pressure after resolving.
Null Field Null Action. Self, 10-ft aura until the start of your next turn. Allies in the aura have advantage on 
saving throws against psychic powers. Hostile psykers inside the aura increase Warp 
Pressure by +1 when using a power.
Silence the Witch Null Reaction. When a creature within 60 ft uses a psychic power, force it to make a Charisma 
save. On a failure, it adds +1d4 to any Perils severity roll caused by that power.
